arStrings.szText: ...foolish and in love, Philios created the Sightless Eye to speak with Lycander in the High Heavens. The other angels grew suspicious; Sanctuary was at risk of being discovered.
Formal, an entry in a historical record.
Lycander believed their love was too great a risk. And though his heart ached, Philios agreed, hiding the Eye deep within the waters of Skovos...
Formal, an entry in a historical record.
